Initial release — easily add AI-generated background music to your videos in seconds.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB and get music-enhanced videos automatically.
- No need for editing software; describe your desired mood or style, and the AI selects suitable background music.
- Secure, cloud-based rendering pipeline delivers results in 30–90 seconds.
- Session management, credits, and export handled automatically, with clear status and helpful error messages.
- Ideal for content creators who want fast, automated music additions without manual audio editing.
